title: C2 · Mastery
description: Communicate with near-native precision, subtlety and rhetorical control.

objectives.can_do: I can recognise and use rhetorical devices to persuade.
objectives.title: Recursos retóricos

activities.instruction: Make a persuasive point using at least two rhetorical devices.
activities.target: metaphor / rhetorical question / parallelism / understatement

activities.instruction: Without looking, name three rhetorical devices.
activities.target: metaphor / rhetorical question / parallelism

activities.instruction: Use rhetorical devices to persuade about a topic you have not discussed.
activities.target: metaphor / understatement / rhetorical question

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can recognise and use rhetorical devices to persuade.

activities.instruction: On your own, make a persuasive point using at least two rhetorical devices.
activities.target: metaphor / rhetorical question / parallelism

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.

objectives.can_do: I can use advanced grammatical structures for rhetorical effect.
objectives.title: Advanced structures for rhetoric

activities.instruction: Write a persuasive sentence using parallelism and one using ellipsis.

activities.target: parallelism = same structure / ellipsis = omitted words

activities.instruction: Use parallelism on a topic you have not written about.
activities.target: parallel structure

activities.instruction: In one sentence, say what you learned to do in this unit.
activities.target: I can use advanced grammatical structures for rhetorical effect.

activities.instruction: On your own, write a persuasive sentence using parallelism and one using ellipsis.
activities.target: parallel structure / omitted words

options: She likes running, swimming and hiking.
She likes running, swimming and to hike.
She likes to run, swimming and hiking.
I can and will help you.
I can and I will to help you.
I can and will to help you.
